fabricationFlags: All programs carry programType 'degree' though AOLCC is a private career college issuing only diplomas/certificates, not degrees
Program slugs include odd phrasing copied from aggregator (e.g. 'diploma-apply-for-dental-assistant-course') rather than the official program name 'Dental Administrative Assistant'
currency set to 'USD' for a Canadian institution; tuition would be CAD
evidence: Catalog sourceUrl is the edvoy aggregator. The real official site is academyoflearning.com; the matching campus is the Scarborough McCowan & 401 location (https://www.academyoflearning.com/locations/ontario/scarborough-mccowan-401/, programs at /programs/). The official programs page lists 36 diploma/certificate programs that align well with the catalog's 24 (Computer Service Technician, Microcomputer Business Applications, Business Administration, Medical Office Assistant, Network Administrator, Software and Web Developer, Home Inspection, etc.), so programs and the Scarborough, ON campus (1457 McCowan Rd, Unit 208) are accurate. Tuition is empty in the catalog and not published on the official site, so prices are unverifiable; the catalog lists no scholarships or accommodation, so both are absent.
